description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Polimorphic is revolutionizing local and state government services through its AI-powered platform, including CRM, workflow, case management, and citizen engagement tools. The Full Stack Engineer will build features across the platform, develop core infrastructure and AI capabilities, collaborate with customers and product teams, and help transform constituent-government interactions.
Full-stack engineer building civic technology features for government constituent interactions and shaping products with public-sector customers

Responsibilities:
• Build the key features our clients (cities, counties, and states) use. Your work will touch millions of people every time they interact with their local government
• Incorporate feedback from our users across America
• Partner with customers and our product team to shape product features and vision
• Contribute to a platform that leverages AI to transform constituent-government interactions
• Our stack is built in React/Typescript & Django/Python. Experience in either is not required
• We are based in Chelsea - NYC and are an in person team

Requirements:
• Experience in full stack web development
• Strong back-end development skills
• Experience building enterprise or consumer software
• Ability to collaborate effectively with non-technical teams
• Comfort delivering software in a fast-paced startup environment
• Interest in applying technology to improve state and local government
